_comment: Vertical-stack region 1 of 3: outdoor selva wood + colle plateau + chapel exterior (facade, walls, plinth, roof). Player enters chapel_interior via the chapel-door trigger; player descends from chapel_interior into limbo via the descent-bottom trigger. All three regions are RESIDENT in physics + render at all times (multi-resident architecture per [[feedback_seamless_world_traversal]]) so the player can see across seams.

terrain_modifiers._comment: Chapel exterior plateau. Terrain depresses to plinth-bottom Y (kChapelGroundY 22.3 - kPlinthHeight 0.30 = 22.0) around the chapel footprint, extended forward by the door-threshold ramp length (0.50m) so terrain covers under the ramp. Soft 2m blend on -X/+X/-Z, SHARP +Z edge at the threshold OUTER face (-205.5). See [[feedback_structures_own_terrain_seam]].

Corridor wedge FlushSlope. Terrain follows the descent corridor's ceiling roof down for ~7.74m past the chapel back wall (Z=-214 to Z=-221.74) so the gap between chapel back and natural terrain is filled by terrain sloping along the corridor roof. value at -Z edge (far_z=-221.74), value_far at +Z edge (near_z=-214, chapel back wall). Slope = kStairRise/kStairTread = 0.4571 per m.

triggers._comment: Stepping onto the chapel-door threshold ramp from outside fires this trigger. transition_mode Instant + preserve_player_pos true: the player's world coords are valid in both surface and chapel_interior (one continuous world), so we don't teleport -- we just swap the current region for trigger-context purposes. Multi-resident architecture means the chapel_interior mesh was already drawn this frame; the player visually walks right through.
